findings.title: Ingress sends traffic to a Service that does not exist
findings.cause: Ingress web sends traffic to Service web-api (for shop.example.com/), which does not exist in namespace kd-ingress-missing-service, so the controller answers those requests with an error (usually 503)

evidence.command: kubectl get ingress web -n kd-ingress-missing-service -o jsonpath='{.spec}'

evidence.what: there is no Service web-api in namespace kd-ingress-missing-service

findings.fix: Correct the backend Service name in the Ingress, or create the Service.
